answer: One wharf, one maker, one hour of real work, that is the whole of it, and it cannot be shortened. Proof of bookbinder spine via bookbinders guild holds the measure: a spine the bookbinders guild tools only after the binder sews a quire he actually folded. The juniper is the maker, the ocean the hour, and a cheat who wants the measure without the work must forge 23 makers and 23 hours, and the forgery still smells of fresh ink.
